source: Rocklabs academic research CLOB archive, manifest snapshot SHA-256 db969fce2d2bf554743fbe486e6537066b826326771c4de48ec41f4b2019e109
event_unit: one verified Up token and one end-minus-120-second endpoint per confirmed event
candidate_universe: all 2016 fixed five-minute calendar slots queried by exact Gamma slug; only identity-confirmed events enter roster, never selected by prints or result
label: CTF Up/Down token and binary payout verified post hoc; label publication time unknown means RETROSPECTIVE_OFFLINE

quote.source: price_change explicit best_bid and best_ask, no snapshot-top fill
quote.history: one midpoint 30 seconds before decision, same 1000 ms age limit, median impute with shared missing indicator

snapshot.source: latest complete book received by decision
snapshot.require: finite positive prices and sizes, two sides, no repeated level, noncrossed top
features: log1p(touch bid size + touch ask size)

model.R1: offset logistic with 3-column train-fitted logit spline and shared quality/missing controls Z
model.R2: R1 plus spread and 30-second midpoint move
model.R3: R2 plus the two snapshot quantity features
model.regularization: L2 on nonintercept coefficients; lambda = 1/(C * number_of_train_events)
model.selection: lowest 2026-07-30 log loss, tie smaller C; never refit train plus calibration

score.primary: mean of three forward-day mean log losses; events equal within day
score.continue_threshold: gain >= 0.005 nats, at least 2 of 3 days positive, Brier not worse, R3 not worse than the better of R0/R1
